steps.title: Enter mobile number
steps.notes: Tap focuses the phone-number field (merged Compose node containing the +91 prefix) before typing; assertion checks the typed digits landed in the field per the doc's Step 2.

steps.title: Post-login prompts
assertions: Allow WheelsEye to send you notifications?
steps.notes: Assertions are checked strictly (knownNonBug left false by default, per project policy — never set true automatically). In this harness (autoGrantPermissions=true, noReset with a previously-dismissed sideload dialog) these two dialogs have not reappeared on recent runs, so this step may legitimately FAIL until a human reviews and decides whether to mark it knownNonBug:true via plan_tool.sh patch, or update the source doc.

steps.title: Home page
steps.notes: Login lands directly on the Home page in this harness (see Step 4 notes) — no notification/unauthenticated dialogs to dismiss first, so no dismiss taps are needed.
